page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ic5.3xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The instance provisions 12 vCPUs across 6 physical x86_64 cores with two threads per core. Memory allocation stands at 12.0 GB, providing an unusually lean ratio of 1.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware features include support for AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI vector extensions, alongside dedicated CPU allocation and 35 MB of shared L3 cache. Network baseline throughput is configured at 4 Gbps, while no local disk storage or hardware GPU accelerators are included.

Benchmark results demonstrate mid-range performance across parallel tasks alongside lower per-thread throughput. Multi-core operations place firmly in the average tier, as reflected by a Geekbench multi-core score of 5055.0, a PassMark CPU score of 10093.16, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 43.18 GB/sec. Software compilation via Clang (8090.0) and static web serving (7.85 GB/sec) also maintain middle-tier throughput. Conversely, single-thread metrics show distinct limitations: Geekbench single-core scored 995.0, single-threaded gzip compression registered in the lowest 10% at 19.27 GB/sec, and stress-ng single-core placed in the bottom 25%.

The constrained 1:1 vCPU-to-memory ratio represents a key architectural tradeoff. While memory read bandwidth reaches 493.24 GB/sec for small cached blocks and 57.8 GB/sec uncached, the PassMark memory benchmark placed in the weak tier at 1653.05. The low total memory profile directly impacts memory-intensive workloads; for instance, medium-sized LLM prompt processing slows to 14.46 tokens/sec, and large LLM models cannot be executed. The configuration is most cost-efficient for compute-bound, low-memory tasks where applications need multiple CPU execution threads without paying for surplus RAM.

Workloads well aligned with the ecs.ic5.3xlarge profile include distributed CI/CD build runners, parallel microservice web servers, computational image rendering, and CPU-driven batch processing tasks that fit strictly within a 12.0 GB working footprint.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ic5.3xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual instance equipped with 12 vCPUs across 6 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 physical cores at 2.5 GHz and 12.0 GB of system memory. Operating on the KVM hypervisor with an x86_64 architecture, it includes vector support for AVX-512 extensions, 4 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and zero local storage or GPU hardware. The instance exhibits a distinct 1.0 GB per vCPU ratio, creating a focused compute density profile. Benchmark data shows standard multi-threaded throughput, including a PassMark CPU score of 10093.16 and 8.63 million Redis SET operations per second, counterbalanced by modest single-threaded performance and strict RAM capacity limitations. This instance is best suited for horizontally scaled compute jobs, parallel compilation pipelines, and static web serving workloads requiring high core density over memory capacity.
